limitations: The matched compiler comparison is native OA versus ptxas -O3 on identical PTX; it is not an exhaustive cuBLAS/cuDNN/compiled-framework benchmark.
The initial variant inputs use seed+kernel_index: OA/ptxas within one row share exact inputs; cross-layout seed is not matched. Followup fixes this.
A same-PTX scalar4 win can disappear when both compilers use a better vectorized layout; best-observed table must accompany these wins.
Tanh-GELU backward fails the unchanged original analytic FP64 gate for both compilers in ten cases. No speed is admitted from failed rows.
All pointwise kernels use FP32 or unsigned32 arithmetic; no BF16/FP16 backward arithmetic admission follows.
Cross entropy fixes label zero, returns per-row loss and unnormalized gradient; dropout consumes a provided mask; norms have no learned affine terms.
Graph timing excludes launch/submission overhead and keeps data resident; graph/event resolution matters near2–3us.
There is no complete-transformer or tokens/sec claim in this operator file.
